title: A$^2$-VLA: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Policies to New Tools through Agentic Affordance Discovery
title_zh: A²-VLA：通过智能体自主发现可供性，将视觉-语言-动作策略适配到新工具
abstract_en: Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes. Validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools. Finally, A$^2$-VLA uses encoded functional-region features as conditioning inputs to a $π_{0.5}$ backbone during training and inference. Evaluation examines affordance reliability in reconstructed scenes and real-robot task success on unseen tools. Our method achieves 86.1% success in simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting based on affordances. On three real-robot tool-use tasks, A$^2$-VLA improves task success by 30.7 percentage points over $π_{0.5}$.
abstract_zh: 形状不同的工具可以实现相同功能，但要在工具之间迁移操作技能，机器人必须理解哪些几何属性与任务相关，并据此调整操作方式。A²-VLA 将具身智能体与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略结合，把工具可供性（affordance）视为可提出、检验和修正的假设。给定少量源工具的遥操作示范，智能体在仿真中重建场景，自主识别与任务相关的功能区域及其关键几何属性，再通过实验迭代改进这些特征及其提取方法。通过验证的提取技能被存入可复用的技能库，用于处理未见工具。训练和推理时，A²-VLA 均将编码后的功能区域特征作为 π₀.₅ 主干的条件输入。基于可供性的跨工具轨迹重定向在仿真中的成功率为 86.1%；在三项使用未见工具的真机任务中，A²-VLA 的任务成功率较 π₀.₅ 基线提高 30.7 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 将工具可供性建模为可检验的假设，重点识别完成任务所需的功能区域及其关键几何属性，而非匹配工具的整体外形。
从少量源工具的遥操作示范重建仿真场景，通过自主实验同时改进可供性特征与提取技能，并将验证后的技能存入可复用的技能库。
在训练和推理阶段，均以编码后的功能区域特征为条件，引导 π₀.₅ 适配未见工具。
仿真中跨工具轨迹重定向的成功率为 86.1%；三项真机工具使用任务的成功率较 π₀.₅ 提高 30.7 个百分点。
